title: First game is done
author: vantage_games
selftext:
I used Fable 5.2 to create this game, curious if anyone would want to try it.

It's called space zombies vr on meta quest. The process of making it was really fun. I incorporated aspects of other vr games I liked and combined elements of past games I really enjoyed like zombie mode in COD and the obnoxious Tony Hawk playlists. 

I made all the songs in Suno and as much as I could overall, I tried to infuse the overall vibe I was going for. 

So, check it out if you can, curious to know how I could make it better.

Also made a version for the browser and mobile, but it was sort of meant to be played in vr.

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/vantage_games please expand this post with how you used AI during development. It's not enough to say you used AI. Tell us what you did with it. The point of Rule 4 is for promotional posts to give something back by sharing the process and actual development. We're cracking down on posts that only advertise. If you don't update, this may be removed.

comments.author: Fancy-Proof-9449
comments.body:
The logging part is the best thing in here. I do the same for a phone game, since Claude can't hold the phone either. Session stats, first run, did they come back another day.

One trap if you put the mobile version on Google Play: every upload gets installed on Google's own test phones for the pre-launch report, and they show up in your stats as real players. In my first month they were 36 of 84 "players", every single failed purchase, and every switch to portrait. I almost went chasing a broken store that wasn't broken. Worth filtering those out before you read anything into your numbers.

And agreed on fun. It can build what you describe, but whether a boss feels right only comes from playing it.

replies.author: vantage_games
replies.body: Ah, yeah. I mainly made it for VR (honestly a little hard to play on mobile) but my brother asked for it and it only took Claude a couple hours to rebuild as a mobile game.

comments.author: vizyn
comments.body: Nice work.  The loop is fun, but it did lose me at the first "boss" when he just stood in one place because he couldn't cross the bridge (even after smashing it) making the whole thing trivial.  Curious what led to that decision?

replies.author: vantage_games
replies.body: Thanks for the feedback. Yeah, as I was ideating on the game the idea of bosses seemed like a good one, but maybe it’d be better just incorporated to the level? The bosses aren’t as fun as the waves imo

replies.author: vizyn
replies.body: I think the boss' concept was fine but idk if he was stuck or what but he just stood in one spot the whole time
